A '''Remote Fuse''' was a [[timer]] used on explosive devices. Available to buy in [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceports]] and large [[City/Legends|cities]] for one hundred [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], the sale of the devices were restricted.<ref name="SWS" />
